relations.label: dus gsum mkhyen pa (3855) lineage predecessor of ras chen pa dpal grags (8421)
relations.zotero_refs:
[RCJ46BHM]: 329 records lineage of Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Nāgārjuna (ID:3720), Āryadeva (ID:3702), Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Mātaṅgi (ID:8412), Tailo (ID:5641), Nāro (ID:5639), Mar pa (ID:6968), Mi  la (ID:8405), Dwags po (ID:4189), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), 'Gro mgon Ras chen (ID:8421), sPom brag pa (ID:8427) Karma pa Pakṣi (ID:8417), Auḍyāyana pa (ID:7346), Rang byung rdo rje (ID:3897), g.Yung ston rdo rje dpal (ID:8418), Rol pa'i rdo rje (ID:7397), mKha' spyod dbang po (ID:3901), De bzhin gshegs pa (ID:6785), Ratnabhadra (ID:6927), mThong ba don ldan (ID:6159), 'Jam dpal bzang po (ID:8428) and/or dPal 'byor don grub (ID:8420), Chos grags rgya mtsho (ID:8419), sNye bo/'og Go shri (ID:8430), rJe btsun Ras pa chen po (ID:8429), Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895). 

[RCJ46BHM]: 330-336 records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Maitrīpāda (ID:6109) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Maitrīpāda (ID:6109), Mar pa (ID:6968), Mi la (ID:8405), Dwags po (ID:4189), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), after which it is the same lineage as the Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329). 

[RCJ46BHM]: 337 also records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Jo bo Dīpaṃkara (ID:3745) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Nāga (ID:3720), Āryadeva (ID:3702), Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Rig pa'i khu byug che (*Vidyākokila) (ID:7788), (Rig pa'i khu byug) chung (i.e. a wa d+hu ti) (ID:7963), Jo bo Atisha (ID:3745), sTon pa chen po (i.e., 'Brom ston rGyal ba'i 'byung gnas) (ID:3827), sPyan snga ba (Tshul khrims 'bar) (ID:3830), Bya yul pa (ID:3915). Then from many unspecified bKa’ gdams pa masters to Lord sGam po pa (ID:4189). 

Alternatively, from Bo to ba (i.e. Po to ba) (ID:3829), Sha ra ba (ID:3869), to Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the first lineage of Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329). 

 

[RCJ46BHM]: 338 records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Pa tshab lo tsā ba (ID:3868) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Mañjuśrīkīrti (ID:8424), Devacandra (ID:8431), Brahman Ratnavajra (ID:7726), Parahita (ID:3798), Hasumati (ID:6180), Pa tshab Lo tsā ba (ID:3868), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the  lineage of Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329).

comments:
First Karmapa.
His birth name was dGe 'phel ([Y6NGTTC6]: 24). His alternative names and epithets are listed in [Y6NGTTC6]: 5 and 27, which also lists the main information on his life found in early sources.
Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), Sho sgom (ID:3857), and Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856) are known as the "grub thob mi gsum" and as the "khams pa mi gsum." According to Dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar in Si tu Chos kyi 'byung gnas's Karma kam tshang gser 'phreng (cited in [I58Z22ET]: 408, n. 42), Dus gsum mkhyen became known as one of the "khams pa mi gsum" during his stays in gSang phu (ID:4332) (gsang phur yang bzhugs te | khams pa mi gsum du grags |).
